consultation.name: Expert Consultation
consultation.shortDesc: Detailed analysis of your project idea and eligibility check.
consultation.fullDesc: Our experts provide comprehensive analysis of your project, assess grant eligibility, identify potential funding sources, and create a strategic roadmap for your application.

editing.name: Application Editing
editing.shortDesc: Professional revision of your existing grant proposal.
editing.fullDesc: We refine your existing proposals with professional editing, strengthen weak points, improve clarity, and ensure compliance with funder requirements for maximum impact.

smeMonitoring.name: SME Business Monitoring
smeMonitoring.shortDesc: Weekly curated list of grants for small and medium enterprises.
smeMonitoring.fullDesc: Receive a carefully curated weekly digest of grant opportunities specifically tailored for your business. Stay ahead of competition with exclusive grant alerts.

standard.name: Standard Package
standard.shortDesc: End-to-end development of local grant applications.
standard.fullDesc: Complete grant writing service from research to submission. Includes strategy development, documentation preparation, and submission support for local and regional grants.

vip.name: VIP Package
vip.shortDesc: Complex international grants like Horizon Europe or LIFE.
vip.fullDesc: Premium service for complex international grants. Includes dedicated project manager, multi-round submissions, stakeholder coordination, and comprehensive support throughout the entire process.

ngoMonitoring.name: NGO / Micro Monitoring
ngoMonitoring.shortDesc: Focus on social projects and micro-grants for startups.
ngoMonitoring.fullDesc: Specialized support for nonprofits and startups. Curated micro-grant opportunities, simplified application processes, and grant writing specifically designed for social impact projects.

about.title: About Impactum
about.subtitle: Meet Our Team
about.missionDesc: We analyze the business model, find weak points and strengthen them to make your application look convincing to the donor.
